product_summary: Email finder, verifier and B2B contact database plus cold-email sequences, sold via app, MCP server and API; returns each contact with the public sources it was found on.
current_data_sources: Public web pages crawled daily (30M pages/day, 650M public sources)
Indexed professional email addresses (150M) tied to person and company records
B2B firmographic and technographic company data (Discover database)
Intent/signals data layered on existing leads

api_or_integration_evidence.quote: Using the Domain Search API, you can fetch all email addresses Hunter found for a given domain.
Every contact is found and verified, never guessed.
Sync Hunter data to HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, or Pipedrive, and push contact details plus email activity to 5,000+ Zapier endpoints.

newsletter_capability_detail: Searched hunter.io/our-data (the page that documents sourcing), /api, /mcp, /b2b-database and site:hunter.io newsletter. Newsletter appears only as outreach templates (newsletter-swap, sponsor-slot templates) and blog content, never as an ingested source or a data product.
verified_gap: Hunter documents its ingestion as crawling public web pages to extract professional contact information, with source records attached. It has no newsletter publication index, no article-level topic/guest/sponsor extraction and no publication momentum tracking, so it cannot show which newsletters covered a company or who sponsors them.

evidence.quote: we maintain an index of the entire web and use it to source verified email addresses
All the contacts in the Domain Search are returned with information about where and when we found them.
Answers come from Hunter’s data from 100M+ companies and real email addresses, not the model’s best guess.
Programmatically identify your target audience. Use natural language or robust filters to find companies aligned with your ICP.

likely_buyer_role: Head of Data or VP Product for the Data Platform/API (data sourcing and enrichment roadmap)

contact_route.note: Address publicly listed in Hunter's site footer (verified on the pricing page); hunter.io/contact is a form, no named data lead published.

caveats: Hunter already crawls the open web and sells 'signals', so they could build newsletter extraction in-house; the pitch must be corpus + entity resolution + momentum history rather than raw crawling. Their API is a real integration surface (MCP, Zapier, CRMs) but they are a much larger vendor with in-house data engineering.
